bullets.text: Built an expense-splitting app for hostel roommates, who were tracking shared costs in a group chat and losing track of who owed whom.
Settled each group's debts in at most n-1 payments with a greedy min-cash-flow algorithm instead of pairwise repayments.
Grew to 140 students across three hostels in the first semester, spread entirely by roommates inviting each other.
Used optimistic UI updates with server reconciliation, so expenses added offline sync cleanly once the hostel Wi-Fi returns.

tutorlink.name: TutorLink
tutorlink.stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Tailwind CSS

bullets.text: Built a marketplace matching college tutors with school students, replacing word-of-mouth tutoring that left most tutors underbooked.
Rendered listings with Next.js server components over PostgreSQL through Prisma, keeping the client bundle small on low-end phones.
Reached a Lighthouse mobile performance score of 96 after optimising images and splitting the bundle by route.
Prevented double-booked slots with a database exclusion constraint rather than application checks that race under load.

pixelforge.name: PixelForge
pixelforge.stack: Python, FastAPI, Celery, Redis, Pillow, MinIO, Docker

bullets.text: Built an image-processing API for resizing and watermarking uploads, so small shops stop editing product photos by hand.
Moved processing to a Celery worker pool, handling about 60 images per second on a four-core machine without blocking requests.
Cached results by content hash in S3-compatible storage, so repeated requests for the same transform skip processing entirely.
Secured the API with key-based auth and per-key rate limits, returning clear 429 responses with retry-after headers.
Built a generator that turns one JSON file into a static portfolio site, for students who want a portfolio without writing CSS.
Designed six themes in Tailwind CSS that meet accessible colour-contrast ratios in both light and dark modes.
Reached 210 GitHub stars, with issues and theme requests arriving from students at other colleges.
